svg.title: Politechnika Świętokrzyska — przyjazd i ładowanie EV
svg.desc: A streamlined electric sedan inspired by the Tesla Model 3 drives past the two stone pyramids at the entrance to Kielce University of Technology, stops at an illustrative charging station, charges, and departs. The campus architecture is drawn from a photographic reference. Reduced motion shows the parked vehicle at seventy-percent charge.
